name: INCLUDE (Indian Lexicon Sign Language Dataset) and INCLUDE-50
description: Word-level ISL videos recorded with deaf students of St. Louis School for the Deaf, Adyar, Chennai. INCLUDE-50 is a 50-sign subset for quick evaluation. Official train/test CSV lists are provided.
classes: 263 word signs in 15 categories (INCLUDE-50: 50 signs). No alphabet or digit classes.
size: 4,292 videos on Zenodo (paper reports 4,287); about 0.27 million frames; train 3,475 / test 817; INCLUDE-50 train 766 / test 192; 56.8 GB
signers: Not stated on the Zenodo record. 7 according to comparison tables in the iSign and HWGAT papers.
limitations: Word-level only, so it does not cover the static alphabet/digit task. Single recording site (Chennai), one regional variety, few signers. Whether the official split is signer-independent is not stated on the pages read. The Hugging Face metadata mirror (ai4bharat/INCLUDE) showed some rows where label and video path disagree, so metadata needs checking. 56.8 GB download.
verificationNote: Zenodo record opened 2026-11-21. The record does not state the number of signers; the figure of 7 comes from comparison tables in the iSign and HWGAT papers. The INCLUDE paper itself was not opened.

name: CISLR (Corpus for Indian Sign Language Recognition)
description: Word-level ISL recognition corpus collected from web sources, designed for one-shot / few-shot recognition.
classes: Around 4,700 words (4,765 per the iSign paper's Table 1)
size: 7,050 videos per the iSign paper's Table 1; 1.59 GB on Hugging Face
signers: 71 per the iSign and HWGAT comparison tables; not stated on the dataset page
license: afl-3.0 (Academic Free License 3.0), as listed on the Hugging Face dataset page
limitations: Roughly one video per sign, so it cannot train a conventional classifier; suited to one-shot evaluation or as a prototype gallery. Gated: users must log in and accept conditions. Web-collected, so recording conditions vary. No alphabet-specific subset identified.
verificationNote: Hugging Face dataset page and the ACL Anthology abstract page opened 2026-11-21. Word, video and signer counts come from Table 1 of the iSign paper, not from the dataset page.

name: iSign
description: ISL-English benchmark built from YouTube ISL content (ISLRTC, ISH News, Deaf Enabled Foundation) with video, pose and text for translation, pose generation, word/gloss recognition, word presence and semantic similarity tasks.
classes: Not a classification dataset; about 40k-word English vocabulary
size: 118,228 video-sentence/phrase pairs; 252 hours; 228 GB on Hugging Face
signers: Not stated (each video has a single signer)
modality: RGB video, pose keypoints, English text
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (cc-by-nc-sa-4.0), as listed on the Hugging Face dataset page; the page says it is free for research use but not for commercial purposes
limitations: Non-commercial licence. Gated access. Continuous signing with sentence-level alignment only; not usable for the static alphabet experiment. Very large. Only a 593-pair random sample was validated by certified ISL instructors.
verificationNote: Hugging Face dataset page and the arXiv full text of the iSign paper opened 2026-11-21.

name: FDMSE-ISL
description: Large isolated-sign ISL video dataset introduced with the HWGAT model; frontal RGB 'working dataset' plus additional multi-view and depth data.
size: 40,033 videos; about 36.2 hours; about 7.8 million frames
signers: 20 native deaf ISL signers from southern India (10 male, 10 female)
modality: RGB video (additional multi-view and depth data on request)
license: licence not stated on source page
limitations: The paper says dataset and code 'will be available' at https://cs.rkmvu.ac.in/~isl; that page was not opened, so actual availability is unconfirmed. Additional data is described as research-use only with permission. Word-level only. Southern-India signers.
verificationNote: arXiv abstract page and full text of the HWGAT paper opened 2026-11-21. The dataset's own download page (cs.rkmvu.ac.in/~isl) was not opened, so availability and licence are unconfirmed.

name: ISL-FS (Continuous Fingerspelling Dataset for Indian Sign Language)
description: Continuous ISL fingerspelling clips from ISH News videos paired with the on-screen text. A companion ISL-FS-Dense release with letter-level frame boundaries is announced but had no download link when checked.
classes: Character sequences (38 unique characters reported for ISL-FS-Dense)
signers: 3 (per project page; the paper abstract does not state it)
license: CC BY-NC 4.0, described on the project page as for research purposes only
limitations: Non-commercial licence. Continuous fingerspelling at natural speed with coarticulation, not isolated static letters, so it cannot directly train a static letter classifier without the frame-level annotations. Only 3 signers from one news channel, so signer-independent evaluation is weak. Published baseline has a very high error rate.
verificationNote: Project page and ACL Anthology page opened 2026-11-21. Signer count is from the project page.

name: ISL Fingerspelling Image Dataset (IEEE DataPort)
description: High-resolution images of static ISL fingerspelling hand gestures captured against two backgrounds with varied lighting. Authors: Dongare, Nawani, Deshpande, Shaikh, Javale (MIT World Peace University). DOI 10.21227/796w-a432.
size: About 400 images per class, over 14,000 images; 286.63 MB
license: Creative Commons Attribution (as stated on the source page; version not stated). Access requires an IEEE DataPort subscription.
limitations: Subscription needed to download, so not freely accessible. Only 3 signers: a leave-one-signer-out protocol is possible but gives a weak estimate. No digit 0. Whether signer IDs are included in the files is unknown until the files are inspected. Image content was not inspected (no downloads).
verificationNote: IEEE DataPort record page opened 2026-11-21. No files were downloaded or inspected.

name: ISL-CSLTR
description: Sentence-level ISL dataset for continuous sign language translation and recognition (Elakkiya and Natarajan, Mendeley Data, DOI 10.17632/kcmpdxky7p.1).
classes: 100 spoken-language sentences (186 words per the iSign paper's Table 1)
size: 700 videos; 18,863 sentence-level frames; 1,036 word-level images (from search-result extracts of the record)
signers: 7 (from search-result extracts and the iSign paper's Table 1)
license: licence not confirmed: source page could not be opened
limitations: Unverified: data.mendeley.com could not be opened from this environment (TLS certificate error). Small sentence set. Not relevant to the static alphabet experiment. Licence must be read on the source page before any use.
verificationNote: Not verified. data.mendeley.com could not be opened from this environment on 2026-11-21 (TLS certificate error). The description comes from search-result extracts; the iSign paper's Table 1 independently lists 186 words, 700 videos and 7 signers.

name: ISLRTC Indian Sign Language Dictionary
description: Official ISL dictionary of the Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre, offered as a dictionary website, YouTube videos, a Google Drive folder and a data.gov.in catalogue entry. The authoritative reference for what a sign should look like; a reference resource rather than a machine-learning dataset.
classes: Dictionary terms. News reports give 10,000 terms for the third edition (2021); this count was not confirmed on an ISLRTC page.
license: licence not stated on source page (the ISLRTC home page only says content is owned by ISLRTC, DEPwD, MSJ&E)
limitations: Unverified as a dataset: the ISLRTC home page was opened and links the dictionary, but the dictionary site (connection refused) and the data.gov.in catalogue (HTTP 403) could not be opened, so size and reuse terms are unconfirmed. Typically one demonstration per term, so not enough to train a classifier. Written permission from ISLRTC should be sought before any reuse beyond linking.
verificationNote: Not verified as a dataset. The ISLRTC home page was opened 2026-11-21; the dictionary website (connection refused) and the data.gov.in catalogue (HTTP 403) could not be opened.
